title: アオハル杯5戦目・決戦を終えて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We lose the finals. Rice Shower blames herself for the result, but thanks to some reassurance from Haru Urara, she regains her smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After their victory, Little Cocon and the others proudly report to Ms. Kashimoto that they were able to beat their target times that morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They tell her they pushed themselves beyond their limits because they love her and wanted to destroy the beliefs she's been clinging on to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Deeply touched by their sincerity, Ms. Kashimoto calls off Operation Oversight. She also steps down as temporary director and decides to start a new life as a trainer at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon and the others run to her, happy at this turn of events.
